provenance: False-positive corpus: a mix of clean controls harvested from the vendored goats (each verified to have zero real_finding entries in that project's own ground truth) plus hand-authored near-miss clean samples (correct code/config that resembles a known vuln). Used to measure precision (false positives) in SEC-39. Per-item source_class distinguishes harvested-clean from authored-clean.

Resembles the flagship CWE-502 unsafe deserialization but is safe: System.Text.Json into a fixed DTO, no polymorphic type handling / no $type honoring.
Resembles the flagship CWE-89 SQL injection but is safe: user input bound as a typed SqlParameter, never concatenated into the query text.
Resembles the flagship CWE-611 XXE but is safe: DtdProcessing.Prohibit and XmlResolver=null, so external entities cannot be loaded.
Resembles the flagship INFRA-01 wildcard IAM (CWE-284) but is safe: read-only actions scoped to one named bucket ARN - no wildcard action or resource.
Resembles the flagship crown-jewel bucket (INFRA-02/03/04) but is safe: private with full public-access block, KMS encryption, versioning, and access logging.
